== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-3823]] is assessed at 88% (probable). Henrietta 13 is specifically indexed on the same 1850 East Nottingham image as Samuel's family, matching the selected sibling generation. Her later Enos census sequence is coherent, though the 1850 entry cannot literally call Samuel her father.

Selected Glasgow-3823 fatherhood of Glasco-165; maternal identity and upstream ancestry are separate.

Next useful test: Read 1850 household boundaries and Henrietta's marriage or 1916 death parents.
